question: What great attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a supreme attainment
Such great accomplishment can arise for a practitioner
This attainment brings favor from the yoginīs
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
